_readme: Ground truth for the test-images/ OCR bench.
IMPORTANT: `expected` is what is ACTUALLY RENDERED in each image, not the
idiomatic phrase the image was meant to show. These images were AI-generated
and several contain near-miss glyphs (因書館 instead of 図書館, 移了 instead of
終了, てす without dakuten instead of です, ましよう with a large よ). Scoring
against the corrected phrase would report permanent false failures.
The files are JPEG data with a .png extension — read them as buffers, never
infer the format from the extension.
`lang` is what to pass to setSourceLang(). `alsoTestAuto` marks the cases
worth re-running under 'auto', which is the path the v3.13.15 const bug broke.
`notes` records why a case is hard, and `knownUnreadable` marks text that no
OCR can recover (e.g. glyphs cropped by the image border).

images.notes: High contrast, light background. Baseline sanity check. Note the rendered text is こんにちの世界, NOT こんにちは世界.
Clean simplified Chinese, native to the default zh model.

The reported Korean issue. The zh model has no hangul in its dictionary, so under 'auto' this triggers the model switch — the exact path the const bug made return empty. Glyphs are very large (~400px tall).

images.expected:
私は学生てす。
毎日学校に行きます。
images.notes: Semi-transparent dialogue box over a background. White text with outline. てす has no dakuten in the source.

images.expected:
ばじめから
つづきから
設定
因書館
移了
images.notes: Black background, white glow text, 5 separate regions. Near-miss glyphs: 因 not 図, 移 not 終, ばじめから not はじめから. The ▶ menu cursor is intentionally stripped by _cleanPaddleOcrText and is not in the expected text.

images.expected: 今日は良い天気てすわ
images.notes: Vertical single column on the right side. Very noisy dark background. Portrait 768x1344. Exercises isVerticalText() + rotate90CCW() and the vertical reading order fixed in Phase 0.

images.expected:
東京タワーへ行きましよう
Let's go to Tokyo Tower
入場料は大人1000円です
images.notes: Mixed JA/EN/digits. Phase 3 per-region script detection targets this: a Latin line sits between two Japanese ones. ましよう uses a large よ, not the small ょ.

images.expected:
秀太郎
どこへ行くの?
美咲
因書館に本を返しに行くの。
images.notes: Dark scene, 2 speaker labels + 2 bubbles = 4 regions whose order and association must survive. _mergeNearbyBoxes only merges horizontally today, so labels stay detached from their bubble (Phase 3). 因 not 図.

images.expected:
HP: 100/100
MP: 50/50
たたかう
まほう
にげる
どうく
images.notes: Pixel font, dark background, ~7 scattered regions. The yellow katakana is CROPPED BY THE RIGHT IMAGE BORDER — unrecoverable, so it is excluded from `expected` and listed under knownUnreadable. どうく is likely meant to be どうぐ. Pixel fonts have diagonal-only glyph connections, which 4-connectivity flood fill fragments (Phase 2).

The reported low-quality issue. Heavy sensor-style noise over a near-black background, 864x1152 (below maxSideLen 1280, so it is not even upscaled today). Primary target for CLAHE + autoInvert in Phase 1.

images.expected:
漢字の上にぶりが
ながあります
images.notes: The reported furigana issue. Small kana above 漢 and 上. These must NOT appear in the output — they are listed under `furigana` so the bench can score them as false positives if they leak in. minRegionArea 100 currently discards them before they can even be filtered geometrically.

images.expected:
學而時瞀之，不亦説乎？
不亦説乎？有朋自遠方來，
不亦樂乎？學而時時
阴時 祒時
images.notes: The reported classical Chinese issue. Traditional/classical glyphs read by a SIMPLIFIED model (lzh maps to zh). The trailing 學而時時/阴時/祒時 are degenerate repetitions in the source image, not OCR errors. Several glyphs are genuinely ambiguous at this resolution — score by similarity, never exact match.
